mapper.select:
select * from (SELECT a.birth_date AS birthDate,a.user_code AS usercode,a.user_name AS username,a.name, CASE WHEN a.gender = 1 THEN '男' ELSE '女' END AS sex, c.signId_date AS diaryTime,c.habit_id FROM yh_user_reginfo AS a INNER JOIN yh_user_make_card AS b ON a.user_code=b.user_code INNER JOIN `yh_life_habit_sign` AS c ON a.user_code=c.user_code WHERE b.doctor=(SELECT id FROM `yh_user_admin_info` WHERE user_code=#{usercode})
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{nameLike},'%')
AND a.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{usernameLike},'%')
AND c.signId_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(#{strTime},'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
) AS b GROUP BY b.diaryTime
HAVING (select count(*) from yh_life_habit_sign where signId_date=b.diaryTime and user_code=b.usercode)>=(select count(*) from yh_life_habit_person_dict dict,yh_life_habit_dict habit where dict.habit_id=habit.id and dict.finish_tim is null and dict.increase_date<=b.diaryTime and dict.user_code=b.usercode)
HAVING (select count(*) from yh_life_habit_sign where signId_date=b.diaryTime and user_code=b.usercode)<(select count(*) from yh_life_habit_person_dict dict,yh_life_habit_dict habit where dict.habit_id=habit.id and dict.finish_tim is null and dict.increase_date<=b.diaryTime and dict.user_code=b.usercode)
order by diaryTime desc
SELECT * FROM(select * from yh_life_habit_sign where DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) <= date(signId_date)) AS b GROUP BY b.user_code;

SELECT * FROM(select sig.*,cate.category_name from yh_life_habit_sign sig,yh_life_habit_dict dict,yh_life_habit_dict_category cate where sig.habit_id=dict.id and dict.habit_type=cate.id and sig.user_code=#{userCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and sig.signId_date>=#{signidDate} and sig.signId_date<=#{signidDate1}) AS b GROUP BY b.habit_id;
